title: StoreGroup
description: A grid store's root zarr.json (docs/zarr-profile.md, "Group document"): profile 2, a shared store holding every bundle of one tier by id in xue_bundles, or profile 1, one bundle's store (a series store, a segment of a round from before shared stores, or any store published before them) holding its metadata in xue. A segment of a rolling window is an ordinary profile 2 group. The readers' own checks: that xue_profile is one they implement, that a group carries exactly one of xue and xue_bundles and not xue_polar or xue_network (polar-group.schema.json, network-group.schema.json), and the one bundle they open by id. Consolidated metadata is absent from a store written before it, and xue_index, from before that, is ignored.

xue_profile.description: This profile's version: 2 for a shared store, 1 for a one-bundle store.

xue_bundles.description: Bundle id to that bundle's metadata, verbatim, in manifest bundle order.

xue_index.description: A whole-store index object of the profile's first stores; ignored.

ConsolidatedMetadata.description: The Zarr v3 inline form: every array document of the store, verbatim, the variable arrays first, bundle by bundle, then the coordinates.
